0xe1c7392a.notice: Runs the PRNG module initializer. MUST be invoked via the diamond's `initialize` `_init` delegatecall.

natspec.notice: One-shot initializer for a PRNG diamond — registers the IHederaPrngAdapter interface (ERC-165) and nothing else: the module is stateless (the seed comes straight from the system contract at call time, so there is no subscription, no keeper and no request book to seed). Delegatecalled by {Diamond.initialize} inside the initializing window (so it must NOT open its own pre/postInitializer).
